title.suggested: Allen and Davis Go Into Training

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported excitement and heavy betting on the coming fight between Bill Davis and Tom Allen; both went into training that day, Davis under Bill Blake, 'Dublin Tricks', who had trained Mike McCoole.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, December 7, 1868'. The St. Louis Republic name only dates from 1888.

facts.fact: Allen and Bill Davis went into training for their fight; Davis's fighting weight was given as 185 pounds, more than Allen would carry

notes: The short item is entirely about the Allen-Davis contest, so focus is primary.
